meta.title: RFQ bid: Save the bid as a draft and submit later

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's buyer Responses tab as required for this state.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Enter the 100 quote and save it as a vendor-side draft without submitting.
Return to the buyer's Responses view to inspect the draft's visibility.
Assert that the buyer sees no submitted response while the vendor quote is only a draft.
Return to the vendor's existing pricing sheet to submit the saved draft.
Assert that the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's Responses view after submission.
Assert that exactly one direct vendor response now appears for the buyer.
Assert the submitted response is labeled Current Bid 1 as expected.
